name: customer-onboarding
description: Design structured customer onboarding programs — time-to-value optimization, activation milestones, kickoff calls, 30-60-90 day plans, handoff from sales to CS, onboarding playbooks by segment, and onboarding health tracking. Use when building customer onboarding, reducing time-to-value, designing kickoff process, or scaling onboarding from founder-led to team-led. Triggers on: "customer onboarding", "time-to-value", "onboarding playbook", "kickoff call", "sales-to-CS handoff".
